system.description: You spend a Willpower Trait and Mental Traits to raise wind speeds to around 30 miles per hour with gusts up to double that, forcing ranged gun attackers to bid two extra Traits and bow or thrown-weapon attackers to bid three extra Traits. You may knock people down by winning a Mental Challenge against their Physical Traits provided they are outdoors or otherwise exposed to the wind, costing them their next turn to stand; local temperature may also be shifted by up to 20 degrees Fahrenheit. This power generally does not function well indoors, unless the space is large enough.
system.duration: Minutes to a day depending on Traits spent
